def control(obs):
    h=obs.get('hitch_deg',0.0)
    prev=globals().get('_h',h)
    dt=max(obs.get('dt',0.1),0.1)
    dh=(h-prev)/dt
    globals()['_h']=h
    steer=max(-12.0,min(12.0,1.3*h-0.18*dh))
    return (steer,-0.4,-41.0)

def control(obs):
    h = obs.get('hitch_deg', 0.0)
    prev = globals().get('_h_prev', h)
    dt = max(float(obs.get('dt', 0.1)), 0.1)
    dh = (h - prev) / dt
    globals()['_h_prev'] = h
    steer = max(-28.0, min(28.0, 1.7*h - 0.10*dh))
    return (steer, -0.35, -41.0)
